name: – Ana Catarina Mendes – § 79 – Am 16
title: REPORT on the Commission’s 2024 Rule of Law Report
part_text: 79. Deplores attempts to bypass national governments by introducing the notion of ‘smart conditionality’, which would violate the MFF; stresses the democratic legitimacy of Member States’ governments, as opposed to non-governmental organisations (NGOs) and CSOs that do not have the same legitimacy and do not contribute to the EU’s budget;
